record.question: India's only active volcano is located in:
record.explanation: Answer C: Barren Island. Barren Island in the Andaman Sea is India’s active volcano. Reference: https://www.incredibleindia.gov.in/en/andaman-and-nicobar-islands/sri-vijaya-puram/barren-island. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
